snippet.title: ClayTown Horror | Update 1.5 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce that Update 1.5 for ClayTown Horror is now live. This update brings a lot of overhauls to the whole experience of the game. From mechanic balancing, to completely rebuilding the house, and creating a brand new monster, Update 1.5 changes and improves a lot of the game.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771780/ClayTown_Horror/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/TheNightmareJar
Community Discord: https://discord.com/invite/fZnV2X9TTJ
